page_template: Place the tile at 1:1 scale on a sheet supported by the actual machine, then trim if needed. Do not assume a 100 mm card can be fed directly.
review: A source change or process change requires fresh proof hashes, individual visual inspection, device-output inspection and touch review.
source_concepts: Keep stable edu./aac. concept IDs and meaning-specific category paths. Collage geometry is reference material, not proof of process compatibility.
semantic_encoding: Explicit dot-rendered lines and filled areas; no meaning encoded only by grayscale or assumed height differences.
reference_specs: Current Basic-D V5 page describes 500 DPI / 0.05 mm positional placement. This is not a minimum physical dot spacing; older 50 DPI descriptions are not the current capability contract.
import_route: Index Braille Tactile Graphics advertises SVG import and direct embossing. Verify exact importer, scale, graphics mode and driver on the selected device.
controls: Exact Index model/generation, firmware and graphics engine
Paper stock and supported sheet size, simplex test layout
Minimum practical dot spacing, curve continuity, independent filled areas and gap preservation
limitations: Single-height is our conservative portability baseline, not a claim about every Index device. Do not produce generic BRF full-cell pictures or an unverified PRN file.
